oracle.description: The player floats upward while blocking after being released by the rival near the wall, then flies out of bounds.

triage.title: Mounted fighter launches out of arena when crate breaks
triage.rootCause: ground.js:94-96 releases the mount without waking the rigid body when RULES.mountReleaseFix=0, leaving floor contact stale; the fighter sinks through the floor and is ejected upward next to the wall, then flies out of bounds (oob) while airborne.
triage.playerImpact: The player is launched far outside the arena and floats helplessly until the round ends.
